frames.narration: Full fine-tuning trains every weight. For a 4096 x 4096 matrix that is 16777216 weights, each with a gradient and optimizer state.
LoRA freezes W. It learns two thin matrices instead: B (4096 x 8) and A (8 x 4096).
That is 2 x 4096 x 8 = 65536 trainable weights, about 0.391 percent of the matrix.
Only the adapter needs gradients and optimizer state: 1 MiB instead of 256 MiB for this matrix.
The examples train the adapter. B starts at zero, so the model begins as the original and moves away only as far as the data pushes it.
The result is a small adapter file. One shared base model can serve many customers, each with its own adapter, or the adapter can be merged into W with no extra delay.
